hero.title: Your map to automotive and safety-critical embedded software engineering
hero.summary: Build durable system understanding, practise difficult engineering decisions and connect architecture, implementation, assurance, verification, certification and technical leadership.

concepts.title: Functional Safety Management
concepts.summary: Understand the governance, evidence and decision system that keeps the ISO 26262 lifecycle controlled.

concepts.title: Confirmation Measures
concepts.summary: Distinguish confirmation reviews, audits and assessments and understand the evidence each one evaluates.

concepts.title: RTOS Concurrency and Timing
concepts.summary: Reason about priorities, blocking, interference and worst-case response rather than average CPU load.

concepts.title: Android and Android Automotive
concepts.summary: Trace features through Binder, services, HALs, permissions, SELinux and the Vehicle HAL boundary.

concepts.title: Airborne Software Lifecycle Assurance
concepts.summary: Connect planning, independence, evidence, programme tracking and certification readiness across the airborne software lifecycle.

concepts.title: Model-Based Aerospace Software
concepts.summary: Define the assurance boundary for Simulink, Stateflow, generated code, tool use and target verification.

caseStudies.title: Brake and ESC safety architecture
caseStudies.summary: Connect vehicle behaviour, safety goals, technical safety requirements, monitoring and release evidence.

caseStudies.title: AAOS vehicle signal flow
caseStudies.summary: Follow a signal from the vehicle network through the platform and into an application, then analyse authority and failure boundaries.

caseStudies.title: AUTOSAR communication diagnosis
caseStudies.summary: Investigate signal, PDU and network-management behaviour across COM, PduR, CanIf and lower layers.

caseStudies.title: Airborne engine-control evidence chain
caseStudies.summary: Trace a safety-critical control change through requirements, Stateflow design, generated code, target/HIL verification, coverage and certification data.

scenarios.title: Difficult technical scenarios
scenarios.summary: Work through timing, memory, boot, integration, diagnostics and cross-layer failure investigations.

scenarios.title: Technical management decisions
scenarios.summary: Balance architecture integrity, evidence, staffing, suppliers, schedule and release readiness.

scenarios.title: Product Owner scenarios
scenarios.summary: Prioritise common features, customer value, platform reuse, variability and product-roadmap commitments.

scenarios.title: Engineering Manager scenarios
scenarios.summary: Lead globally distributed technical teams through dependencies, capability gaps and high-stakes delivery choices.

scenarios.title: Certification, audit and aerospace lead scenarios
scenarios.summary: Resolve derived-requirement gaps, failed tests, structural coverage findings, SOI readiness issues and high-pressure programme decisions.

playbooks.title: Review a functional-safety plan
playbooks.summary: Check lifecycle scope, ownership, milestones, suppliers, confirmation measures and evidence closure.

playbooks.title: Investigate an embedded timing failure
playbooks.summary: Move from symptom to task, interrupt, blocking, resource and worst-case timing evidence.

playbooks.title: Plan an AUTOSAR integration
playbooks.summary: Connect system design, ECU extract, configuration, generation, BSW ownership and integration gates.

playbooks.title: Make a release decision
playbooks.summary: Evaluate quality, residual risk, evidence gaps, rollback, field observability and accountable approval.

playbooks.title: Close a structural-coverage gap
playbooks.summary: Classify uncovered code, connect it to approved intent, select additional verification or correction, and preserve problem and certification evidence.

roadmaps.title: Functional Safety roadmap
roadmaps.summary: From lifecycle foundations and HARA through system, hardware, software, validation and safety release.

roadmaps.title: AUTOSAR architecture roadmap
roadmaps.summary: From VFB and system design through BSW, communication, OS, RTE and integration troubleshooting.

roadmaps.title: Embedded platform roadmap
roadmaps.summary: From execution fundamentals and firmware through RTOS, Linux, AAOS, OTA, reuse and leadership.

roadmaps.title: Safety-Critical Aerospace Software roadmap
roadmaps.summary: From DO-178 lifecycle planning and requirements through model-based development, target verification, structural coverage, SOI and technical leadership.
